create_experiment: create a new Sacred Experiment instance with a name and optional ingredients for managing ML experiment configuration
run_experiment_commandline: run the Sacred Experiment command-line interface by calling run_commandline to parse sys.argv and execute the default command
run_experiment_programmatically: run a Sacred Experiment command programmatically by calling run with config_updates and named_configs to start a Run
define_main_function: define the main function of a Sacred Experiment using the @ex.main decorator to mark it as the default command
add_option_hook: add an option hook function to a Sacred Experiment using @ex.option_hook to modify command-line options before a run is created
